title: Returned-Payment Makeup Amount — Installment Payment Plans Calculation Note
content:
For a returned payment on a plan of the **Installment Payment Plans** billing an Owner Auto Policy term, the makeup amount is defined from the plan's ledger as follows (US dollars).

**The returned payment.** It is the payment most recently returned on the plan; of two returns posted the same day, the one recorded first. Its **returned amount** is the total returned against it. **Its invoice** is the installment invoice that payment had paid.

**Fees owed with it.** Every NSF fee posted for the returned payment and every late fee posted for its invoice, less every waiver that reverses one of those fees.

**Standard makeup.** The returned amount plus the fees owed with it. A makeup payment is never more than the plan's account balance.

**Assembly.** The makeup is the amount re-collected for the returned payment, plus the fees owed with it, plus any further amount carried ahead with it, whether set as a figure or as a percentage of the returned amount; each part acts on the quantities above and none on another's result, and the total, capped at the account balance, is rounded half up to the cent once.

**No makeup figured (0.00).** When the returned payment has already been made good (a payment referencing it stands on the plan), or when it falls outside the makeup schedule's limits — a plan billing a Named Non-Owner Policy term; an owner term backing two or more certificates; an installment invoice of the returned payment carrying another payment besides the returned payment itself and makeups referencing it; or the plan's next installment invoice, already issued, carrying two or more payments.

**Worked figures (hypothetical).** A draft of 182.40 that had paid an installment invoice with a minimum due of 182.40 is returned for insufficient funds; an NSF fee of 25.00 is posted for it and a late fee of 10.00 for its invoice, and the late fee was later waived. Fees owed: 25.00 plus 10.00 less 10.00, which is 25.00. Standard makeup: 182.40 plus 25.00, which is 207.40. On a plan whose account balance is 150.00, the makeup is capped at 150.00.
